sentence: Your broppelganger cannot deliver your peterpeanemis for you.

wombos.definition: A bro who looks strikingly similar to you — your bro-coded double, a friend who could pass as your twin.
wombos.example: Everyone thinks we're brothers — he's literally my broppelganger.

wombos.definition: A peak cinema analysis delivered at a quick, compact pace — a small but rapid critical breakdown.
wombos.example: Give me the peterpeanemis — I only have two minutes before the movie starts.
